Hi Liam —

Hope you're doing well. Storix's renewal window is coming up in October and we wanted to start the uplift conversation now so we can align timelines and stakeholders. High-level items we want to cover:

- Term amendment options (12 / 24 months) and pricing impact
- Capacity uplift scenarios (steady staircase vs. one-time uplift)
- Rollout plan and target SLOs for peak batches
- Security & procurement asks to unblock contract signatures

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines milestones and a proposed timeline. Could you share the right procurement and security contacts who need to be in this thread? Also, does the week of Aug 20 look reasonable for a kickoff QBR where we walk through options and confirm the mutual action plan?

Next steps I propose:
1) You share internal stakeholders and any timing constraints by EOD Friday (8/9)
2) We confirm a 60-min QBR in the week of Aug 20 and circulate pre-reads
3) Redwood to deliver firm uplift pricing and a short SOW draft within 3 business days after QBR

Attaching: Mutual_Action_Plan_Storix_v2.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — look forward to getting this moving.

Connor O'Brien

Connor —

Appreciate the heads up and the MAP. The week of Aug 20 works well for us; my preference would be Tue Aug 20 afternoon (ET).

I've looped in Rina (procurement) and our security alias — they'll want a short list of pre-reads and a tentative pricing range before the QBR so procurement can provision time on their side.

A couple items from our side:
- We're evaluating an aggressive throughput uplift for holiday season traffic; would like to see both a staircase plan (30/60/90% steps) and a one-time capacity bump so we can compare cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Legal will likely ask for a shorter conditional pilot term if we take a larger uplift up front — any flexibility on that?

I'll volunteer these attendees for the QBR: myself (Product), Rina (Procurement), Neha Shah (Security), and Priya Verma (Infrastructure). If you need any additional context from our invoices or usage windows, I can attach a short usage export prior to the meeting.

Best,
Liam
